1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 18 m de altura, de follaje espeso, con hojas grandes y ovaladas y flores vellosas de un verde castaño; su madera, de color rosado, es útil para construir puntales y como combustible. Rhamnaceae Colubrina arborescens.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching heights of up to 18 m, with dense foliage, large oval-shaped leaves, and velvety flowers of a brownish-green color; its wood, of a pinkish hue, is useful for constructing stakes and as fuel. Rhamnaceae Colubrina arborescens.
